run_roberta_privacy_synthesis: run the main function to synthesize private text samples using RoBERTa with differential privacy
run_nn_histogram_dp: run the NN_Histogram dp_nn_histogram to compute differential privacy nearest neighbor distances for private samples
produce_variation_text: produce text variations from surviving parent samples using the Variation module with a mask schedule
chunk_examples_text: chunk long text examples into fixed-width 100-word segments for dataset preprocessing
prepare_roberta_model: prepare a RoBERTa masked language model with 8-bit loading and accelerator for evaluation mode
